title: Quarto Progress Indicator
text:
About this Extension
This extension adds a premium, interactive progress indicator to your Quarto presentations.






Key Feature


Built fully native as a Quarto Lua Filter — just one single file, zero external dependencies.



View on GitHub

title: Quarto Progress Indicator
text:
How It Works

Native Lua Filter: Clean integration with your Quarto project via filters:.
Intersection & Mutation Observers: Intelligently tracks active slides and layout changes.
Auto-hide: Fades out automatically when the presentation is idle.
Persistence: All custom colors, shortcuts, and settings are saved to localStorage.

title: Quarto Progress Indicator

Full Color Persistence
All color changes are automatically saved to localStorage:

✅ Active dot color
✅ Inactive dot color
✅ Label text color
✅ Background color

You can also rely on Theme Inheritance: The extension automatically detects your Reveal.js theme and pulls its primary accent color on startup!

title: Quarto Progress Indicator
text:
Per-Slide Dot & Bar Control
Open settings (i) and scroll to Slide Visibility.
Each slide has two independent checkboxes:



Column
What it controls




Dot
Include this slide as a dot in the indicator


Bar
Show the indicator bar when on this slide









Note


All visibility settings are saved automatically — changes persist across reloads.

title: Quarto Progress Indicator
text:
Class-Based Hiding
Alternatively, add .hide-progress to any slide:
## Q&A Slide {.hide-progress}
Or use .skip-progress to omit a slide from dots while keeping the bar visible.

title: Quarto Progress Indicator
text:
Override Slide Counter
Enable “Page Number: Dots Only” in settings to replace the default slide counter with a dot-based count:

Regular counter: 5 / 18 (total slides)
Dots-only counter: 3 / 12 (only counted dots)







Tip


Dots-only counter automatically updates when you add or remove slides from the indicator using the Slide Visibility Manager.

title: Quarto Progress Indicator
text:
Installation
quarto add ofurkancoban/QuartoProgressIndicator

title: Quarto Progress Indicator
text:
YAML Setup
filters:
  - ofurkancoban/progress-indicator

format:
  revealjs:
    progress-indicator:
      position: "bottom"    # top | bottom
      alignment: "center"   # left | center | right
      style: "dots"         # dots | bar
      hide-on-title: true

title: Quarto Progress Indicator

Extension Overview
This extension adds a premium, interactive progress indicator to your Quarto presentations.






Native Implementation


Built fully native as a Quarto Lua Filter — zero external dependencies required.

title: Quarto Progress Indicator
text:
Key Features

Section Grouping: Group slides neatly under section headers.
Single-Slide Sections: Seamless handling for single-slide sections (e.g. References, Thank You).
Auto-hide & Idle Fade: Fades out automatically when presentation is idle.
Theme Inheritance: Automatically adopts accent colors from your Reveal.js theme.
